## Elevator Pitch

Most growth agencies sell deliverables. We sell outcomes. AIREA operates as your embedded growth department — a single system of strategy, paid media, AI creative, CRM, and measurement — led by a Fractional CMO. We combine proprietary AI systems (NOVA Creative Studio, Andromeda Protocol, AIREA Performance Framework) with senior human strategy to deliver results you can see on your P&L, not just in a dashboard.

## The Six Growth Pillars

### 1. Amplify — Performance Marketing
Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok paid media run algorithmically. We treat ad platforms like a quantitative trading desk: systematically testing creative, scaling winners, cutting losers in real time.

**Capabilities:** Meta Ads, Google Search & PMAX, Streaming Ads, Geo-Targeting & Conquesting, Andromeda Protocol, Creative Testing & ROAS optimization.

**Benchmarks (client averages):** 4.5x ROAS · -40% CPA · 50+ creative variations / month · 93% client retention.

### 2. Intelligence — AI Workflows & Technology
Custom AI workflow design, process automation, and internal tool development. AI is the engine; people are why clients stay.

**Capabilities:** AI Workflow Design, AI Creative Suite, Tech Stack Optimization, Internal Tool Development, Process Automation, AI Education & Training.

### 3. Reach — Email, SMS & CRM
Lifecycle marketing that turns one-time guests into regulars and regulars into advocates.

**Capabilities:** Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, CRM Foundations, Retention Flows, Lifecycle Marketing.

### 4. Engage — Content & Social
A unified social presence reflecting your brand. AI-powered creative production at magazine quality for a fraction of traditional cost.

**Capabilities:** Social Media Strategy, AI-Powered Creatives, Video Production, Ad Creatives, Brand Identity, Event Collateral.

### 5. Analyze — Data & Insights
Real-time dashboards replace monthly PDFs. Attribution, forecasting, and quarterly strategic reviews tied to P&L.

**Capabilities:** Real-Time Dashboards, Revenue Forecasting, AI Smart Recommendations, Quarterly Strategic Reviews, Full Channel Attribution.

### 6. Build — Web & Development
Architecturally sound, visually stunning sites designed to convert visitors into guests.

**Capabilities:** Website Design & Development, Webflow & Shopify, Custom Development (React/TypeScript/Python), Landing Pages, App Development, Technical SEO.

## Flagship: NOVA — AI Creative Studio

NOVA is our proprietary AI creative engine. It produces brand photography, product shots, lifestyle imagery, video, and advertising creative at magazine quality — indistinguishable from traditional production at a fraction of the cost, with unlimited iteration and full brand consistency.

**Use cases:** Hospitality lifestyle imagery, e-commerce product catalogs, seasonal campaign assets, social content at scale, ad creative variation libraries.

## Proprietary Systems

### The Andromeda Protocol (Meta)
Our creative testing system that treats the Meta ad platform like a stock market.
- 50+ creative variations deployed monthly via Dynamic Creative Optimization
- AI identifies top 10% performers; underperformers paused automatically
- First-party data lookalikes and retention loops
- **Results:** -40% CPA · 3.5x avg ROAS lift · stable scale over time

### AIREA Performance Framework (Google)
Our Google Ads architecture.
- PMAX for local dominance
- High-volume low-cost keyword targeting
- NTM (Non-Trademark) segmented by category
- TM (Trademark) to protect branded search
- Competitor Conquest to capture neighboring intent
- **Results:** +120% conversions, CAC under $2 (representative case: ONE40 Rooftop)

## FAQs

**Q: What's included in the monthly retainer?**
Each package has a defined scope. You always know what you're getting, who's doing it, and what it should deliver. Ad spend is always separate.

**Q: Is ad spend included?**
No. Media budgets are scoped collaboratively based on your market position and strategic goals.

**Q: Can I switch packages?**
Yes. Scale up or adjust scope with full transparency as your needs evolve.

**Q: Who will I work with day-to-day?**
Every partner gets direct access to Nicolas Santos as Fractional CMO. Senior thinking, not junior execution.

**Q: What's the minimum commitment?**
We recommend 3 months to properly embed and demonstrate results. We don't lock you into long-term contracts.

**Q: Do you work with brands outside hospitality and fashion?**
Our specialty is lifestyle categories (hospitality, retail, beauty, fashion). We are selective about partnerships outside those verticals.

**Q: How is AIREA different from a traditional agency?**
Traditional agencies sell deliverables and layer on junior account managers. AIREA operates as your embedded growth department — one integrated system led by a Fractional CMO, powered by proprietary AI.

**Q: How is AIREA different from an AI company?**
We are not an AI company that happens to do marketing. We are marketers who wield AI. AI is the engine under the hood. People are why clients stay.
